name: Pizza Rollups
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Pizza spices as desired (anise, basil, fennel, garlic, oregano, etc.)

steps: Unroll 2 croissant rolls and place together on ungreased cookie sheet, pointing in opposite directions, forming a rectangle by pinching sides together.
Lay 6 slices of pepperoni on top of each dough rectangle.
Lay a slice of provolone cheese on top of pepperoni slices.
